_note: The five clickable reactor parts. 'id' must match the SVG group id in index.html. 'materials' are keys in chains.json.

parts.label: High-temperature superconducting magnets
parts.description: Confine the plasma in compact tokamaks, using magnets wound from REBCO superconducting tape.

parts.label: Low-temperature superconducting coils
parts.description: Confine the plasma in ITER-style reactors. The superconductor is niobium-tin (Nb₃Sn).

parts.label: Divertor & first wall
parts.short: Faces the plasma, takes the most heat
parts.description: The divertor faces the plasma directly and takes the most heat. Its plasma-facing surface is made of tungsten, which is also the leading choice for future reactor walls.

parts.label: Breeding blanket
parts.description: The breeding blanket breeds tritium fuel and absorbs neutrons. Its key materials, enriched lithium-6 and beryllium, are not traced in this iteration: the public and Sayari data on them is not yet complete enough to show a full chain.

parts.label: Vacuum vessel & structure
parts.description: The vacuum vessel, blanket and support structure hold everything together. They are built from specialty steels, including the low-activation steel EUROFER97 used for blanket structures. These matter for supply, but this research found no major human rights hotspot at this stage.
